card.name: Dose-related modifiers before dosing words
card.fires_on: Words that modify or begin dosing terms, such as "fixed" before "-dose", "depth" of injection or fill, and "adjustment" after "No dosage". Also fires inside split words like commensurate, contraindications and insulin degludec.

modes.label: Fixed-dose and dose adjustment
modes.description: The word "fixed" in fixed-dose products, or "adjustment" after "No dosage".
modes.example: Because TRIUMEQ and TRIUMEQ PD are<< fixed>>-dose tablets and cannot be dose adjusted

modes.label: Depth of injection or liquid
modes.description: The word "depth" for needle insertion or solvent level.
modes.example: Injection<< depth>> of the REBIF Rebidose

modes.label: Inside split medical words
modes.description: Middle pieces of longer words such as commensurate, contraindications or degludec.
modes.example: be given reduced doses commens<<urate>> with their age and physical status.
